info.description: Prompt, contexto y topes de gasto del bot de preguntas frecuentes. Admins only

enabled.description: Master switch. Off hides the bot on the site and makes the endpoint refuse

model.description: Routed through the Vercel AI Gateway, so swapping is just this string

maxAnswerTokens.description: Hard ceiling per answer. FAQ answers should be short

organizationContext.description: Who Las Galias is, how buying works, the tone. Goes into the prompt verbatim

promptExtra.description: Extra rules appended to the prompt. The safety rules live in code and cannot be edited away

fallbackMessage.description: Shown when the bot is off, the daily cap is spent, or the model fails

suggestedQuestions.description: Chips shown under the input as examples

dailyQuestionCap.description: Model calls per day across ALL visitors. The ceiling on a day's bill

ratePerIpPerHour.description: Questions one visitor can ask per hour
